meta.description: Starthermatech (Beijing) Co., Ltd. specializes in low-temperature plasma diagnostics and space electric propulsion testing. We provide turnkey measurement systems including Langmuir probes, Faraday probes, RPA, plasma sources, and micro thrust stands. Serving universities, research institutes, and enterprises with customized products and technical services.
